name: Blade vs. Mallet: PGA Tour Putting Performance and Putter Design (2025-2026)
description: An integrated dataset combining 2025 PGA Tour Strokes Gained: Putting statistics (top and bottom 20 players) with putter equipment classifications (blade or mallet), supplemented by a 2026 Masters Tournament leaderboard and equipment dataset. Created to investigate whether putter design is associated with measurable differences in putting performance among PGA Tour professionals.

spatialCoverage: PGA Tour (United States), Augusta National Golf Club

variableMeasured.name: sg_putting_avg
variableMeasured.description: Strokes Gained: Putting season average. Measures putting performance relative to field average, adjusted for putt distance.

variableMeasured.name: putter_type
variableMeasured.description: Categorical classification of putter design: blade or mallet.

variableMeasured.name: score_to_par
variableMeasured.description: 72-hole score relative to par at the 2026 Masters Tournament.

hasPart.name: 2025 PGA Tour SG:Putting (Top/Bottom 20)
hasPart.description: 40 player records covering the top 20 and bottom 20 players by SG:Putting for the 2025 PGA Tour season.

hasPart.name: 2026 Masters Tournament Leaderboard and Equipment
hasPart.description: 44 player records from the 2026 Masters Tournament including finish position, round scores, and putter equipment classifications.

hasPart.name: Integrated Putter Analysis Dataset
hasPart.description: Full outer join of the two cleaned datasets on player name. 75 unique player records.
